hook: Strike before the enemy moves, then drop a second army from your hand into the middle of the fight.
loop: Play Gusters in order; keep Late units waiting in hand.
Each Gust and Late arrival counts toward permanent growth and gold.
Payoffs: Duke counts the gap, the Storm breaks, the dead ride back.

growth.line: Small capped permanent gains per Gust until the Tier 6 Tower; the big numbers are in-fight multipliers.

feel.early: Gust Pages win fights by hitting first
feel.mid: Hand becomes a second board; play order matters
feel.late: Doubled Gusts, mid-fight arrivals, the dead riding back

stars.why: Holds every Gust and arrival, then releases them doubled at once.
Late unit that grows with every attack before he lands.
Last unit you play Gusts; play order becomes a decision.

card_short.u01: Gusts at Start of Combat; a second Page gains Attack.
card_short.u02: Grows permanently when different allies Gust, twice a fight.
card_short.u03: Last unit you played Gusts; Late arrivals Gust too.
card_short.u04: Late only, never played; on arrival, nearest ally Gusts.
card_short.u05: Gold next turn for 3+ or 6+ Gusts and arrivals.
card_short.u06: Can't move; units played or arriving beside him grow.
card_short.u07: Allies that Gust grow permanently; gains Attack when allies die.
card_short.u08: Next two units along the touching chain Gust.
card_short.u09: Adds Mrs Foul; buffs neighbours; swaps out when she arrives.
card_short.u10: Late; Gusts on arrival; her hits knock targets flat.
card_short.u11: Your first three Gusts also hit enemies beside the target.
card_short.u12: Grows leftmost Late unit in hand per last fight's Gusts.
card_short.u13: Late units arrive sooner and grow permanently on arrival.
card_short.u14: Late; grows per attack made before he lands, then Gusts.
card_short.u16: Lifts the biggest enemy out; it returns later, knocked flat.
card_short.u17: Holds your Gusts and arrivals, then releases them doubled.
card_short.u18: Late; brings back every friendly unit that died, each Gusting.
card_short.u19: Board grows permanently for each different unit that Gusted.
card_short.x01: Late token; swaps in for Mr Fair, gives allies Attack.
card_short.x02: Rules note: nearest ties; Late Gusts count as yours.

builds.name: Squall
builds.line: Start of Combat Gusts clear the front row; the Tower pays off.

builds.name: Late Entrance
builds.line: Fight from hand: Late units land beside The Helm, grow every fight.

builds.name: Calm Before the Storm
builds.line: High Pressure holds everything; it breaks doubled, quadrupled with the Steward.

liked: Late turns the hand into a second board Start of Combat can't touch.
Lady High Pressure's held Storm is the capstone; front or back row matters.
worries: Lady High Pressure plus Steward and goldens: one-burst wipes; her text reads slowly.
Watch: Wild Hunt with Black Cloud; Tower near the top; Couriers make 10-unit fights.
changed: Timing rules filled in: High Pressure's Storm, Late arrival order, Vane's pointer.
Glass now pays for Late arrivals, giving the Late build some gold.
Heron grows a Late unit in hand; Windhover rewards spreading Gusts.
verdict: Rated fun 7, distinct 8; a close second of three, called the most original; for players who love timing puzzles.
